settings.title: Settings
settings.first_configuration_description: Clients connect to this node only. They reach its web apps and, if you allow it, its file server.
settings.host: Public host name or IP address
settings.host_helper: The clients connect to this address. Forward the UDP port to this node if it sits behind a router.
settings.host_tooltip: The address is written in every profile. Remove all the accounts to change it.
settings.host_locked: Remove all the accounts to change the address
settings.port_tooltip: The port is written in every profile. Remove all the accounts to change it.
settings.port_locked: Remove all the accounts to change the port
settings.port_in_use: Another service of the node uses this UDP port
settings.network_tooltip: The HTTP routes kept for the VPN clients use this network. Remove all the accounts to change it.
settings.network_locked: Remove all the accounts to change the network
settings.network_helper: Private IPv4 network of the clients, from /16 to /28
settings.network_not_allowed: Use a private IPv4 network from /16 to /28
settings.network_overlap: This network overlaps a network of the node or of the cluster
settings.link_not_private: The network next to this one, used to link the nodes, is not private. Use a smaller network
settings.auth_mode_locked: Remove all the accounts to change it: the profiles hold the login prompt of this mode.
settings.user_domain_not_found: This user domain does not exist
settings.no_user_domain_description: Create a user domain to check the passwords, or use the certificate only.
settings.totp_required_tooltip: Accounts without an authenticator cannot log in. Without this option, the code is asked only to accounts that set one up.
settings.expose_samba: Open the file server to the VPN
settings.expose_samba_tooltip: Opens the ports of the Samba domain controller of this node and resolves its domain for the clients.
settings.expose_ssh_tooltip: Lets every VPN user reach SSH of this node, also by its private address. Without it, SSH to an address routed in the VPN is refused. The public address is not affected.
settings.ssh_ports_helper: SSH port found at the last save: {ports}. Save again after moving sshd to another port.
settings.ssh_ports_unknown: The SSH port is found when you save.
settings.restrict_apps_title: Keep a web app for the VPN clients
settings.restrict_apps_description: Paste this network in "Allow access from" of the HTTP route of the app. Only the clients of this VPN reach it then.
settings.mode_hub_helper: The users connect to this node and reach the apps of every node that joins it. The network next to the VPN network links the nodes, for example 10.8.1.0/24 next to 10.8.0.0/24.
settings.mode_spoke_helper: This node joins a hub through the cluster VPN. The users of the hub reach its apps and its Samba DC. It has no users and no public port.
settings.choose_hub: Choose the hub this node joins
settings.no_hub_description: Set the role Hub on the roadwarrior instance of another node first.
settings.hub_has_spokes: Other nodes joined this hub. Remove them from the Nodes page first
settings.accounts_exist: This instance has VPN accounts. Remove them first
settings.hub_not_found: This hub does not exist anymore
settings.server_not_running: The hub {hub} is not running. Start it first
settings.not_joined: This node never joined this hub. Save again to join it
settings.link_overlap: The link network of this hub overlaps a network of this node
settings.module_not_found: The hub does not know this instance
settings.csr_mismatch: The request of this node does not carry its own name. Save again
